notClosed.finalObstruction: The prime-gap loss in K7. Berlekamp gives dvd_two_pow only along k = p+1 (K8). Monotone transfer to a general k costs a factor 2^(g+1) where g = k-1-p is the distance to the largest prime p <= k-1, so the transported bound diverges only when g <= log2(p) - omega(1). Rankin-type large prime gaps (g >> log p infinitely often) make that condition fail on an infinite set of k, and under Cramer (g = O((log p)^2)) it still fails. Even a full proof of dvd_two_pow would be strictly weaker than the target, by K1: the target needs W k / C^k -> oo for EVERY C, not for C = 2.
